records.evidence: Michael Trefry directly approved carrying all three of these MLX-only cells under epic-17137, in session on 2026-08-20, in two separate answers on the same day. (1) `reference` and `referenceAudio` were approved alongside this family's operation, precision and adapter records, extending to the minimax_h3_ref twin the same rationale he approved for the minimax_h3 rows on 2026-08-16: sc-18650 activated the Ref2VA route, so the cells became visible to the generated matrix for the first time. (2) `referenceVideo` was approved separately and later the same day, in direct answer to a question naming `models/minimax_h3_ref/conditioningShape/referenceVideo` specifically. It is the NINTH residual MLX-only cell of this family and it did not exist as a residual until PR #2460, which fixed a `referenceVideo => videoClip` mis-mapping in the matrix generator: minimax_h3_ref's only mode is reference_to_video, whose requirement group carries no `videoClip`, so the probe set became six modes the model never routes and the cell read false with no error and owed no approval. Remapping it to `multiReference` in that PR moved `summary.mlxOnlyCellCount` 80 -> 81 and exposed it (`80c1ca842` 72 -> 80 for the Ref2VA activation, then `655939b11` 80 -> 81 for the remap). It joins this record rather than opening a new one because the rationale below already covers it verbatim, so approver, authority, approvedDate and revisitCondition are unchanged. Candle generator support shipped in 06d853b68 (sc-17156), SC-20753 supplied the direct/replay executor, and SC-20754 supplied the accepted q4/q8/bf16 ceiling evidence. The exact remaining work is SC-20756: publish off-Mac transformer_ref rows and make the existing Ref2VA Candle executor scheduler-visible. NOTE FOR AUDITORS: PR #2460's body states that no approval had been received for the ninth cell and that no record would be authored. That paragraph was overtaken by events — the approval arrived later in the same session and the body was never re-synced. See the PR's comment thread, and commit `6a9bc2856`, which added the cell.
